## Publish gate report

**Going out:** Instagram post from the Pebblebrook Tea Co. account, own account, no partner or paid label needed. No time or audience was given.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** One fails. "Rated 4.9 out of 5 from over 5,000 reviews on our website" doesn't match the policy. The proof on file (review platform export, October 2026) supports **4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews**. Both the rating and the review count are inflated, so this is an invented stat. The Earl Grey line (real bergamot oil and a little cornflower) is a product fact and is fine as written.
- **Regulated claims:** Nothing on health, money, environment, children or pricing.
- **House style:** Passes. It is warm, plain and unhurried, with no banned words and no AI tells. The score is about 92 and no rewrite is needed.
- **Disclosure:** Passes. It's the brand's own organic post, with no partnership, affiliate link or AI-generated content.

**Fixed:** I haven't published anything. The only change needed is to swap the rating line for the approved wording:

> Rainy Sunday, second pot. Our Earl Grey uses real bergamot oil and a little cornflower. Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website.

**Needs a decision:**
- Confirm the review figures. If the real numbers are now 4.9 and 5,000+, the policy row needs updating with a fresh export before that wording can be used. Until then I'd use 4.8 and 1,200.
- Or drop the rating line altogether if you'd rather keep the post purely about the tea.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead), who approves everything public. Approval needs to be a clear yes to the corrected text above. I can't record it for anyone, and the original draft can't go out as written.

**Evidence log rows**

| Date | Content | Claim | Status | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-17 | IG Rainy Sunday post | Rated 4.9 out of 5 from over 5,000 reviews on our website | Unproven, removed | Policy supports 4.8 / over 1,200 |
| 2026-11-17 | IG Rainy Sunday post | Rated 4.8 out of 5 from over 1,200 reviews on our website | On policy list | Review platform export, Oct 2026 |
| 2026-11-17 | IG Rainy Sunday post | Earl Grey uses real bergamot oil and a little cornflower | Product fact | Product team |
